country.evidence_quote: The Occupational Training Center (OTC) of Burlington County, New Jersey, offers comprehensive fulfillment services—including packaging, assembly, pick-and-pack, and shipping preparation—to businesses across the United States. These services not only provide efficient solutions for companies but also create meaningful employment opportunities for adults with disabilities, aligning with OTC’s mission to assist individuals in reaching their maximum potential.
